name: Bead Grid Studio
tagline: AI-assisted fuse-bead pattern studio: turn prompts or photos into MARD-coded pegboard blueprints.
description:
Bead Grid Studio combines Anna's AI image and reasoning capabilities with a deterministic, perceptual-color quantization engine (CIEDE2000 + OKLab) to produce build-ready fuse-bead patterns.

**Highlights**

- **Text-to-Bead & AI Photo Simplification**: Generate bead-friendly chibi/pixel artwork or simplify noisy photos via Anna's host image services, then quantize directly into MARD-compatible 221 color codes.
- **AI Pixel Matrix Design + Craft Coach**: Ask Anna in chat to design a custom sprite matrix or generate an assembly/ironing plan grounded in real bead counts and isolated-bead risk analysis.
- **Smart Despeckle & Rare-Color Simplifier**: One-click cleanup of 1-bead stray noise and perceptual merging of <=2-bead accent colors to cut down bead jar clutter.
- **Multi-Pegboard & Making Assistant**: Real 29x29 and 52x52 pegboard partition badges (1-1, 1-2...), hover-to-locate color highlighting, color-by-color progress tracking, SVG/PNG construction sheets, and CSV shopping lists.
